why_agent_cannot: nothing - the domain is dead or looks like a scam
what_human_must_do: Do not touch it: the domain check flagged it. Verify from the project's own X profile.
where_to_resume: python tools/triage.py https://zkcandy.io   # then re-run bulk_apply
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Find the portal link on the homepage The ZKcandy homepage links an "Enter Portal" button to the ZKcandy portal . Sign-up there during the 2024 testnet required an invite code; the current requirement is not stated.
2 Step 2 : Look at the linked Galxe quest The homepage links a Galxe quest . Its tasks and rewards are not described here.
3 Step 3 : Look at the linked Layer3 campaign The homepage also links a Layer3 campaign . Its tasks and rewards are not described here.
4 Step 4 : Check the project's homepage for updates Return to the ZKcandy homepage to see whether the campaign invitation is still shown and which quests it links to.
